verdict.rationale: Statsig ships an official MCP server that lets agents such as Codex, Cursor, Claude Code and ChatGPT "talk to your Statsig projects". It also documents a Console API and product analytics (Metrics Explorer), but nothing shows the MCP server or APIs running analytics or metric queries against live product data to answer growth questions. The Console API is described as CRUD over console actions, and the HTTP API covers gate and config evaluation and event logging. Missing for 10: documented analytics or metrics query tools in the MCP server or API, evidence that agents can query live product or warehouse data, examples of answering growth questions, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent answer growth questions from live product data by running queries through the API or MCP server

citations.quote: The Statsig MCP (Model Context Protocol) server brings the power of Statsig into tools like Codex, Cursor, and Claude Code.
Talk to your Statsig projects from within ChatGPT.
The Console API is the CRUD API for performing the actions available on console.statsig.com without using the web UI.
